title: When ETHFI decides to moon while you’re still staring at the 1‑minute chart
content:
👀 3 AM: “Just one more candle…”
🚀 5 AM: ETHFI spikes 12.8% and my coffee’s gone cold. My leverage is now a roller‑coaster and my sleep schedule is officially a meme.
lesson: If you’re using >5x, set a stop‑loss before the coffee gets cold – otherwise you’ll be the one screaming at the screen.
question: Who else watched ETHFI take off and then realized they were still on a 1‑minute candle? Drop your 3‑am regrets 👇
